hooks.command: bash -c 'S="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/session-start.sh"; if [ "$(uname -s)" = Linux ]; then exec "$S"; elif command -v wsl.exe >/dev/null 2>&1; then case "$S" in /mnt/[a-zA-Z]/*) W="$S";; *) W=$(MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 wsl.exe wslpath -u "$S" 2>/dev/null | tr -d "\r");; esac; [ -n "$W" ] && MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 wsl.exe bash "$W"; fi'
